book.name: Irhuka
book.title: Isarhe iyiki Ize iyi Irhuka aka atsɛng

content: Izũwũ utsɛ̃rhãpfu
Uyesu aka abera arhi anyã, abi ubin aka atsuyi izũwãmbɔ ri ijara izũwã ru ufɔm Iya-Num.
Unga ikɛi anyã utsũwũ utsɛ̃rhãpfu iganga aka atsuke ungwɛ̃rhĩ íshaa imang ivaa umɔ.
Unga agɛ, <<Umum indɛyiwa umbi idzidzɛrhe, utsũwũ utsɛ̃rhãpfu uwurɛ atsu ananga abɔɔ kishoo.
Kishoo adzowe izũwãmbɔ ri iwu ru ubinmbɔ. Bɔr unga ri itsũwãnga, unga adzowe kishoo ubinkpi unga aka awu ra ukpɔ.>>
Atsar imimaa upfung
Angwɛ̃ imesanga abɔɔ anu irherhe arherhe ra abinkɛ umbɔ aka akũ agbishu Iya-Num, nggu atarh aka aze nu izũwãyɛ umbɔ aka adzise ru Unum, bɔr Uyesu agɛ,
<<Aba awu abin hã umbi aka azɛrhe, ivanga niyɔ ibarɔ utarh unying umbɔ asi íneke ukpɔɔ utsorhukpɔ nu undɔkakpɔ, awuri isituwe ake kishoo.>>
Umbɔ arhusa unga agɛ, <<A umarhem, ifɛrhɛ ha iwu ukang? Utsar ukpukusong ikɛi umbɔ aka inyã ri ivangyɛ ngge iki iyok?>>
Unga agɛ, <<Àka angwɛ̃dzɛn utsur umbɔ arhɛmmbɔ umbi. Ubinkutsu anera arhɛrhɛ aka iba ri itsokmum, umbɔ awuri igɔr agɛ, <Umum iwu unga,> nu <Ivanga iki iyongge.> Niba adɔsumbi umbɔ.
Umbi aba agũmbi isarhe iwa nu isoyi anang, niba agũmbi iwei. Awu ufang ifɛrhi iyɛrɛ ha igbaashia ikorhe, bɔr isok upfung isi íwengge kata.>>
Mɔcɛ unga agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Abĩ nggu abĩ akase awuri itang iwa nggu adɔkake. Iyɛrha abĩ nggu iyɛrha abĩ akase awuri itang iwa nggu adɔkake.
Umɔ awuri izusu upfunga akarhãrhã, ikɛi imerh nggu ikpo ri inanga irhɛirhɛ. Abin iwei ikɛi nu atsar agɔgɔngake aki idzeka afã.
<<Bɔr umbɔ awuri idzaa umbi uver, na adzowe umbi ra anang aka avarha arherhe aki abi Uyahuda
na atsuke umbi ra abã ifɛn-Num nu ra agborzĩ, na atsu arherhe ri itsimbi ikɛi ra ayɛrhe nu agomna, ubinkutsu umbi awu abimum kata.
Akɛrɛ ha awuri iwu atsĩndĩkɛ umbi aka idɛyiwe umbɔ isarhe ri itsimum.
Bɔr àka atsu amɛnmbi, niba agũmbi ighong ubin umbi aka irherhe akaa atsimbi.
Ubinkutsu umum iwuri idzaamum umbi irhɛm nu itsoi arherhe akirakɛ anggamtsakmbi asi íwembɔ ru uning na akpɛ̃mbɔ.
Ateimbi, angwɛ̃mbi, abi ubãmbi, nu awɛrhambi awuri ighambɔ adakmbi. Awuri ifɛrukumbɔ abɔɔ ru umbi.
Anera kishoo awuri ikpɛ̃mbɔ umbi ri itsimum.
Bɔr igwar itsimbi unying isi ígwirngge.
Awu ibibimambi iwuri ĩdzaa umbi urhɛ.
<<Ivangyɛ umbi aba anyã abi iwa akan adziir Urusharhima, umbi ahwɛngmbi ugɛ itsitsimngge iki iyongge.
Mɔcɛ abirabɛ aka awu ru Uyahudiya atĩ afũ ra akpowa. Abirabɛ aka awu ru utepa atĩ adzeka. Nu abika awu ra awiya niba atsĩmbɔ utepa.
Ubinkutsu ivang iyiki itsu ufai riyɛ, iki itsuifɛr kishoo abinkɛ abika asɔm Arherhu-Num aka atsɛng.
Atorhmbi akatsɛrh abika awu ra ana nu abika akpɔm awɛkaci ri ivang hã! Uver akarhãrhã uwuri icipuwakpɔ nu abĩ, nu avɔm ikɛi iwuri igba ra anera.
Awuri ifɛre abɔɔ nggu akon aka ader, ikɛi awuri idzui abɔɔ akũ azĩ igãrhã ra abĩã kishoo. Atsen abi Uyahuda aba avur Urusharhima ukpɔ uwe ukpumbɔ utsɛki ivangmbɔ iki iba itsuifɛr.
<<Awuri inyãmbɔ atsar ri ishaa unum, ufɛ̃ nu idzɛɛr. Nu abĩã ikɛi, anera kishoo amɛnmbɔ awuri ida, umbɔ awuri igũ ighong akarhãrhã, ru ubvun nu ighwighwii ukau ukugɔng.
Anera awuri igbiwa uvermbɔ uzĩkpɔ iwei ra abin hã aka ikorhe ru upfung, na awuri izusa abin akagɔng afafã.
Ri ivang hã umbɔ aka inyã Ungwɛ̃-Ner iki iba ra amɛɛ nggu ijee ri ikpikpoi akarhãrhã.
Ifɛrhɛ iyɛrɛ iba itirhugge, àka agbisha adɛ̃ɛ̃ aker, ubinkutsu ivang ififɔrhmbi iki iyongge.>>
Uyesu arherhuwe umbɔ unyaka arherhe agɛ, <<Àka arhi ucucii uvorhvo nggu acucii akɔɔ kishoo.
Umbi aba anyã umgbɔ utirhi izɛɛ ayerhe aka afa, umbi nibikambi ahwɛngmbi ugɛ ikpũrhũnga isi idãrhũngge ni iba.
Rimi hã ikɛi, umbi aba anyã ifɛrhɛ iyɛrɛ ikorhungge, umbi ahwɛng agɛ Iyɛrhe Unum iki iyongge.
<<Umum indɛyiwa umbi idzidzɛrhe, udan ukpirɛ usi ítɔngkpɔ utsɛku ifɛrhɛ ha kishoo iki ikorhe.
Afã nggu abĩ awuri itɔngke, bɔr arherhamum asi ítɔngke.
Arherhe isei idzɛu ivang
<<Àka angwɛ̃dzɛn, utsur amɛnmbi ayana atsĩke ri ihwihwa nu amɛn akatãrhã nu ifɛrhkɔ ibee abin upfung. Unum hã uba udzur umbi ru nyaku unggurhi.
Ubinkutsu iwuri iba ra atsi anera kishoo abika awu ru upfung.
Aka adzɛu ubɛn unuma na afɛn-Num agɛ umbi ama akpo iker iyiki ishɔɔr ri kishoo abin hã aka ikorhe, umbi awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃mbi ra asu Ungwɛ̃-Ner.>>
Ubɛn unuma Uyesu amesuwe ru ufɔm Iya-Num, nu untsuuka unga aka isaka adzeku utepa amaa utsuu ni igũyɛ umbɔ iki iyisa Igũ Acucii Uzaitun.
Ubɛn igɔ̃kpeka anera kishoo aka isaka azĩ ru ufɔm Iya-Num agũsha arherhanga.

footnotes.text: 21.12 Abã ifɛn-Num awu anang aka avarha arherhe abi Uyahuda.
